title: Haamu Weapons
description: Gives custom models for items when given specific name
body:
This resource pack gives different items a new model when given a specific name.

For now only models are 

mace with the name: Vel'zhor

netherite sword with the name: Xha'thul

netherite axe with the name: Ragenium Axe


**I am going to make more models when i have time and motivation.**
